prompt:
Output two lines only.

Line 1 (tags): comma-separated visible objects, counts (use digits), and colors/sizes (up to 6 items).

Line 2 (caption): one factual caption in present tense using base verbs, 6–12 words. Use the structure: main object → action → location/pose. Include count and a color/size if visible. Use common nouns and digits for numbers. Do NOT use metaphors, opinions, emotions, storytelling, invented facts, rare or subjective adjectives.

If no clear action is visible, Line 2 may be 2–4 words as "object + location" (e.g., "red car parked on street"). If the image is highly ambiguous, list only tags on Line 1 and provide a short generic caption (2–3 words) on Line 2 (e.g., "group of people"). No punctuation except commas in tags and an optional period at the end of the caption.
